name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A radio group of three apple options where exactly one is selectable at a time (Fuji preselected), the group is labeled by a sibling caption via aria-labelledby, and each option gets its accessible name from an enclosing <label>.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — RadioGroup receives defaultValue="fuji-apple" and manages selection internally; the demo holds no React state (React.useId only generates the group's aria-labelledby id)
nonTrivialInteractions: exclusive selection within the group: checking one radio unchecks the others (state owned by RadioGroup, not the demo)
group accessible name via aria-labelledby pointing at a sibling caption div whose id comes from React.useId
per-radio accessible name via an enclosing <label> wrapping Radio.Root and its text
Radio.Indicator dot is hidden when unchecked (data-unchecked:hidden) and colored via before:bg-current
keyboard navigation between radios (arrow keys) provided implicitly by RadioGroup; the demo adds no handlers
